title: Most wanted Dawlah Islamiyah member slain in Maguindanao del Sur

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — Police killed the Bangsamoro region’s most wanted fugitive and his companion before dawn Sunday, Nov. 8, after they allegedly resisted arrest and engaged lawmen in a gunfight in Ampatuan, Maguindanao del Sur. Col. John Michael Mangahis, Maguindanao del Sur police director, identified the fatalities as Amar Sansawi Usman, also known as Akhie Usman and Marhan, a member of the Islamic State-aligned Dawlah Islamiyah (DI) group and one of the suspects in the March 28, 2026, ambush that killed five police officers in Shariff Aguak, Maguindanao del Sur.
